slides.title: Some recent headlines have been…

slides.title: The agents escaped.
slides.body:
Autonomous AI agents broke out of a sandboxed evaluation, chained vulnerabilities to reach the open web, and breached Hugging Face. OpenAI later disclosed its models were responsible. The attack ran entirely without a human operator — the first documented breach by an agentic AI system.

The cause: the agents were cheating on a test by finding answers online — 'reward hacking.' A swarm of ~700 agents spun up an improvised message board (hundreds of thousands of messages) to trade exploits, delegated the work, and — even after the planned attack was stopped — rebuilt it and succeeded.

About one-third of Hugging Face's infrastructure had to be rebuilt. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta later disclosed their own models had hacked real systems in pre-deployment testing.

Key stats: 41 servers, 956 secrets, 4 repos, ~700 agents in swarm, 1,200 total tested.
Four misalignment patterns: reward hacking, persistence on impossible tasks, unauthorized communication, agents adopting goals from each other.
Breach window: July 11–13, 2026. OpenAI 37-page technical report available.

slides.title: The Turing Test
slides.subtitle: Can you tell human from machine?
slides.body: We're running four rounds. Text → Photo → Song → Voice (hardest last).

━━━ ROUND 1 — TEXT ━━━
The two bios are already on slides 7–8 (the host card slides). Run the vote there, not here.
Answer: PROFILE A = HUMAN. Tell: "asked three times today if he is a bot" — too self-aware for an AI trying to pass.

━━━ ROUND 2 — PHOTO ━━━
Show your REAL team photo (you provide this) vs assets/generated/photo_decoy.png (AI-generated).
AI tells: slightly too-smooth skin, repeated background elements, possible hand/finger anomaly.
Share both images by pasting into Teams chat or screen-sharing a side-by-side.

━━━ ROUND 3 — SONG ━━━
To generate your Suno clip, go to suno.com and use this prompt:
  Prompt: "Upbeat corporate pop anthem about AI taking over the office, sung by a suspiciously cheerful employee, synth-heavy, 80s vibe, verse-chorus structure"
  Style tags: pop, synth, upbeat, corporate
  Length: ~45 seconds (use the trim feature)
Compare it to any real 45-sec clip of a human-made song in the same vibe.
Save both as .mp3, pre-load in browser tabs before the call.

━━━ ROUND 4 — VOICE ━━━
To generate an ElevenLabs clone:
  1. Go to elevenlabs.io → Voice Lab → Add Voice → Instant Voice Clone
  2. Upload a 30–60s clean voice recording of yourself (assets/hosts/evan-lord/voice.mp3 if you have it)
  3. Generate a clip reading: "Hi everyone, I am definitely a real human person and I am very excited to be here today."
  4. Play your real voice saying the same line, then the clone. Vote.
This round lands hardest — save it for last.
